messages:
Emma: Quick sync — we need to lock microcopy for the Hosted / Dedicated / Private landing pages by EOD so engineering can push the updates before Thursday's webinar. Focus: benchmark headline, primary CTA, and lead routing per page.

Kai: My priority is the webinar sign-up UTM + making sure the benchmark narrative has a single metric to highlight (p50 latency reduction). Drafts: 
- Hosted headline: 'Instant API access to production-grade LLM inference'
- Dedicated headline: 'Predictable throughput, isolated capacity'
- Private headline: 'Self-hosted inference with enterprise controls'

Chris: Quick design note — hero needs 2-line max. Can we shorten Dedicated to 'Predictable GPU capacity — SLA-backed'? Also want alternate CTAs: `Start free` vs `Schedule sales consult`.

Zoe: For inbound lead routing: Hosted signups -> HubSpot form `hs_form=hosted_signup` (self-serve). Dedicated -> MQL to SDR queue (assign `lead_owner=sdrcore`), Private -> create enterprise lead + tag `priority:enterprise`. Webinar leads should get `utm_campaign=webinar-inference-2026`.

Sam: I can update Webflow once we lock copy. Who's owning the A/B? I can create variant A/B in Webflow for hero line and CTA. Need final CTAs and destination URLs.

Emma: Proposed CTAs and destinations: 
- Hosted CTA: 'Start free' -> /signup?src=landing_hosted&utm_campaign=webinar-inference-2026
- Dedicated CTA: 'Contact sales' -> /sales?product=dedicated&utm_campaign=webinar-inference-2026
- Private CTA: 'Request evaluation' -> /enterprise?product=private&utm_campaign=webinar-inference-2026

Kai: For benchmark narrative, recommended lead magnet: 1-page PDF 'Latency & Cost: Real-world benchmarks' gated behind email capture. CTA on hosted page to 'Download benchmark' for conversions.

Chris: Microcopy alternatives (short): 
- Hosted subhead alt: 'Deploy in minutes. Scale automatically.'
- Dedicated subhead alt: 'Reserved GPU pools, predictable SLAs.'
- Private subhead alt: 'VPC & on-prem options for regulated workloads.'

Zoe: Quick mapping for HubSpot hidden fields (so SDRs see origination): 
```
form_fields: { "origin_page": "hosted_landing", "campaign": "webinar-inference-2026" }
```
(We'll implement as hidden fields in each form.)

Sam: I'll wire the forms. Who can QA content in staging?

Emma: @Chris can do one pass for spacing and alt copy, @Zoe will verify form fields, @Kai will approve benchmark headline. If all green, Sam can publish staging -> prod tonight.

deploy-bot: webflow: staging publish started for `/landing/hosted`, `/landing/dedicated`, `/landing/private` (job 78543).

Sam: Noted. I'll run the QA checklist post-publish and drop screenshots here.

Emma: Thanks everyone — I've pinned the final copy variants in the Google doc (link shared in DM). If there are major objections speak up now, otherwise we'll ship and use the webinar as the traffic driver for these pages. :rocket:
